profile_text.body:
Cognition is a for-profit AI startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as a team of interdisciplinary makers focused on what it calls the hardest problems in AI, and frames its work as defining a major shift in computing.

Cognition's primary product is Devin, which the company describes as the first autonomous software engineer. According to its site, Devin plans, writes, tests, and ships production code within existing workflows. The company also has a connection to Windsurf, an AI-integrated development environment tracked in the held facts as an AI IDE with source-code exposure considerations. Both products are categorized as security-critical given their level of codebase access and decision-making influence.

The held facts note a significant legal exposure footprint of 175 cases linked to California, though no specific litigation details are recorded. No MCP server registrations or SEC filings are on record for the company.
